summary: The Leviathan Lair is the deepest abyssal throne of the Plane of Water. Here dwells the Leviathan, an ancient tidal titan whose presence shapes the currents, pressure, and darkness of the elemental sea.
history: The lair formed when primordial currents carved a colossal pit into the elemental seabed.
The Leviathan emerged from the abyssal core, embodying ancient water power.
Pressure ridges and tidal caverns formed around the Leviathan’s movements.
The lair became the final trial for those seeking mastery over elemental water.
